events.summary:
...Forecast flooding changed from Moderate to Major severity for the
following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Cocoa 9w affecting Brevard County.

.Heavy rainfall has caused the St. Johns River near Cocoa to rise
into Moderate Flood Stage. The river is forecast to climb to Major
Flood Stage by late this week and remain at Major Flood Stage into
this weekend.

For the St. Johns River...including Cocoa 9w...Major flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and major flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Cocoa 9w.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Flooding to some roads and water
approaching low lying homes in the Silver Pines subdivision in
Rockledge. Many yards, ditches and pastures flooded and water
approaching low lying structures along Pluckebaum Road in Cocoa and
Rockledge. Flooding to low lying structures in the Lake Washington
area of Melbourne.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:15 AM EST Wednesday the stage was 16.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 15.8 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:15 AM EST Wednesday was 16.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is forecast to continue to climb through
Moderate Flood Stage, reaching Major Flood Stage late in the
week.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...The Little Colorado River from Winslow to Leupp...

* WHEN...Until 900 PM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Little Colorado River is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 641 AM MST, the guage on the Little Colorado River at Winslow
remains above Minor Flood Stage. Water levels will continue to
gradually recede, eventually falling below Flood Stage by
Wednesday evening. Flooding impacts will continue downstream at
Birdsprings into Thursday.
- For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 6:00am MST the stage was 21.24 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Forecast: Water levels are forecast to fall below Flood Stage
around 7-9 pm MST.
Impacts:
At 19.0 feet: Overflow on right bank. Water approaches Ames Acres
and Bushman Acres on left bank in Winslow area. Erosion is likely
on the levee on the left bank. Downstream, with approximately 18
hour lag time, the approaches to the bridge over the river on
Navajo Route 71 near Bird Springs will flood and evacuations of
homes near the intersection of Navajo Route 2 and Navajo Route 71
are conducted.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Winslow, Leupp, Birdsprings, Sunrise, Bushman Acres, Homolovi
Ruins State Park and Clear Creek Reservoir.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
